inj.note: It was already known Murray suffered a season-ending elbow injury during the first quarter of Sunday's game versus the Colts, so the move comes as no big surprise. In his absence, 2025 sixth-rounder Rayuan Lane could step into a starting role at safety for the rest of the year.
inj.label: Out for season

news.h: Jaguars DT DaVon Hamilton (quad), S Eric Murray (elbow) out for season
news.d: Jaguars nose tackle DaVon Hamilton and safety Eric Murray both suffered season-ending injuries during Sunday's win over the Colts, coach Liam Coen announced Monday.
